panels.title: Actionable Seat Roster: Logical Identity, Presence vs Activity (Stopped-Seat Guard) & Freshness
panels.description: Joined presence + activity roster keyed by source_namespace + seat_node_id; never classifies stopped/exited/detached processes as idle and flags stale samples.

config.title: Actionable Seat Roster: Logical Identity, Presence vs Activity (Stopped-Seat Guard) & Freshness
config.description: Joined presence + activity roster keyed by source_namespace + seat_node_id; never classifies stopped/exited/detached processes as idle and flags stale samples.

queries.query: SELECT COALESCE(p.openrig_source_namespace, a.openrig_source_namespace, 'default') AS source_namespace, COALESCE(p.openrig_seat_node_id, a.openrig_seat_node_id) AS seat_node_id, COALESCE(p.openrig_seat_runtime, a.openrig_seat_runtime, 'unknown') AS runtime, COALESCE(p.presence_status, 'unknown') AS presence_status, CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.presence_status, 'unknown') != 'running' AND a.active_state = 'idle' THEN 'unknown (stopped-seat guard)' ELSE COALESCE(a.active_state, 'unknown') END AS activity_state, ROUND((date_part('epoch', now()) * 1000000 - GREATEST(COALESCE(p.last_ts, 0), COALESCE(a.last_ts, 0))) / 1000000.0, 1) AS sample_age_s, CASE WHEN (date_part('epoch', now()) * 1000000 - GREATEST(COALESCE(p.last_ts, 0), COALESCE(a.last_ts, 0))) > 300000000 THEN 'STALE: Departed or missing observation (>300s)' WHEN a.active_state = 'needs-input' THEN 'ACTION: Unblock human gate' WHEN COALESCE(p.presence_status, 'unknown') != 'running' THEN 'UNAVAILABLE: Process not running (not idle)' WHEN a.active_state = 'working' THEN 'OK: Executing' ELSE 'IDLE: Running & ready for dispatch' END AS sre_action FROM (SELECT openrig_source_namespace, openrig_seat_node_id, openrig_seat_runtime, last_value(openrig_seat_status ORDER BY _timestamp) AS presence_status, MAX(_timestamp) AS last_ts FROM "openrig_seat_presence" WHERE value > 0 GROUP BY openrig_source_namespace, openrig_seat_node_id, openrig_seat_runtime) p FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT openrig_source_namespace, openrig_seat_node_id, openrig_seat_runtime, last_value(openrig_seat_state ORDER BY _timestamp) AS active_state, MAX(_timestamp) AS last_ts FROM "openrig_seat_activity" WHERE value > 0 GROUP BY openrig_source_namespace, openrig_seat_node_id, openrig_seat_runtime) a ON p.openrig_seat_node_id = a.openrig_seat_node_id AND p.openrig_source_namespace = a.openrig_source_namespace ORDER BY activity_state DESC, seat_node_id ASC

panels.title: Executive Brief: OpenRig Fleet Operations & Governance
panels.description: Executive guide to reading OpenRig fleet capacity, queue velocity, and seat lineage.

config.title: Executive Brief: OpenRig Fleet Operations & Governance
config.description: Executive guide to reading OpenRig fleet capacity, queue velocity, and seat lineage.

panels.markdownContent:
### Executive Brief: OpenRig Fleet Operations & Governance
- **Active Seat Utilization vs. Human Gate Bottlenecks**: Tracks real-time productive seat execution against seats paused on human decisions (`openrig_seat_needs_input`).
- **Queue Completion Efficiency**: Measures end-to-end work item flow (`queued -> notified -> closed`) and highlights dwell-time bottlenecks.
- **Compounding Seat Lineage**: Audits planned seat handovers (`seat_tenure_change`) across logical seats (`source_namespace + immutable nodeId`) and Meshloop orchestration throughput.
- **Cross-Layer Links**: Pair with **envctl-openrig: OpenRig AI Layer** (Folder `50 OpenRig Reliability`) and the **OpenRig Reliability** alert folder for end-to-end autonomous engineering governance.

config.description: Percentage of active OpenRig seats currently executing work.

panels.title: Logical Seat Tenure & Occupant Handover Ledger (source_namespace + node_id Across Occupant Generations)
panels.description: Follows logical seats (durable source_namespace + immutable node_id) across occupant swaps (seat_tenure_change) separately from transient boot_epoch.

config.title: Logical Seat Tenure & Occupant Handover Ledger (source_namespace + node_id Across Occupant Generations)
config.description: Follows logical seats (durable source_namespace + immutable node_id) across occupant swaps (seat_tenure_change) separately from transient boot_epoch.

queries.query: SELECT COALESCE(openrig_source_namespace, 'default') AS source_namespace, COALESCE(openrig_seat_node_id, 'fleet-baseline') AS seat_node_id, COALESCE(openrig_seat_runtime, 'multi-runtime') AS runtime, COALESCE(openrig_tenure_prior_generation, 'baseline') AS prior_generation, COALESCE(openrig_tenure_new_generation, 'current_stable') AS new_generation, COALESCE(openrig_tenure_continuity, 'continuous_no_swap_in_window') AS tenure_continuity, COALESCE(openrig_source_boot_epoch, 'unknown') AS boot_epoch, SUM(CASE WHEN openrig_record_kind = 'seat_tenure_change' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS handover_events FROM "default" WHERE service_name = 'openrig-telemetry-exporter' AND openrig_record_kind IN ('seat_tenure_change', 'queue_transition') GROUP BY openrig_source_namespace, openrig_seat_node_id, openrig_seat_runtime, openrig_tenure_prior_generation, openrig_tenure_new_generation, openrig_tenure_continuity, openrig_source_boot_epoch ORDER BY handover_events DESC, seat_node_id ASC
